text: We evaluated weak-to-strong generalization by training only a linear head on frozen strong features (probe learning rate 0.001), using gpt2-large as the weak supervisor and llama-3.1-8b as the strong student, across num_seeds = 3 seeds. The weak supervisor reached 0.5 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling accuracy was 0.95. Supervising the linear probe with weak labels gave a transfer accuracy of 0.56 with a standard error of 0.07, corresponding to a performance gap recovered (PGR) of 0.13 with a standard error of 0.15, against a baseline PGR of 0.08. Because the PGR standard error of 0.15 is larger than the separation from the 0.08 baseline, this difference falls well within two standard errors and cannot be distinguished from no effect; with only three seeds, the estimate is also imprecise. We therefore report the measurement as inconclusive rather than as an improvement, and note that further seeds would be needed before drawing any directional conclusion about the frozen-feature probing approach.
